reference: Xeon E5-2697 v2 class CPU, RTX 4060, Java 17, warmed assets

feature_workload.notes: Each feature is isolated; ranges are not additive and are not confidence intervals.

feature_costs.label: Pose + conservative bounds
feature_costs.basis: 64-bone 50-instance historical pose probe scaled to 256 and widened for workload/JIT differences

feature_costs.label: Crossfade + one masked layer
feature_costs.basis: Additional clip sampling and local TRS blending; excludes base pose publication

feature_costs.label: Four-leg CCD IK
feature_costs.basis: Four three-joint chains, up to eight iterations, varied target convergence

feature_costs.label: Eight spring links
feature_costs.basis: Eight links, two substeps, four local primitive colliders per instance

feature_costs.label: Four client ground queries
feature_costs.basis: Loaded local chunks, four bounded shape queries per instance; no chunk loading

feature_costs.label: Render pose interpolation
feature_costs.basis: One new interpolated phase per instance, inactive Morph, palettes and bounds rebuilt

feature_costs.label: Active Morph + bounds
feature_costs.basis: Four dense position/normal targets, all vertices affected, CPU delta/bounds work; excludes skinning

feature_costs.label: CPU skinning fallback
feature_costs.basis: Historical 50-instance pose+CPU-skinning minus pose-only, scaled by 256/50 with broad margin; excludes draw encoding

feature_costs.label: Attachment effects bookkeeping
feature_costs.basis: Two emitters and one 32-sample trail per instance; excludes particle simulation and rasterization

scaling.scope: Frozen independent deer poses, four fixed high-bone rigs, two fixed static models, 19 fixed texture groups. Only 70 and 262 are measured. Other points and margins are engineering estimates.
